run_basis: Fresh independent computation from the cached mirror snapshot under this frozen protocol. The committed summary is an observed run, not a reader outcome.

source.data_version: SKEMPI 2.0 CSV mirrored as LiteFold/SKEMPI2 JSONL, revision d17a8bb0ec82ed1a5f34e106106f9d1034d19d07

alignment.rule: Read the value under the 29-field header key inside row. The mirror also stores comma-split overflow fragments as column_N keys; do not rejoin them into inferred fields. Split the header value on semicolons, align by position, and right-pad short values with empty strings. Reject values wider than the header.

entity.row: One upstream CSV record identified by row_index
entity.analysis_subset: Hold_out_type == AB/AG and both parsed affinities are finite and positive

endpoint.missing_rule: Exclude incomplete or nonpositive parsed affinity pairs from the split and metrics, while retaining them in source counts.

split.rule: Sort distinct eligible #Pdb values, shuffle with the fixed seed, and reserve the first ceil(20% of complexes) for test. Fit any group statistics on remaining complexes only.
split.diagnostic: An identically seeded 20% row holdout is used only to count test rows whose #Pdb also occurs in training.

baseline.group_only: Training median log10 wild-type affinity within Hold_out_proteins, with the training-global median for unseen groups.
baseline.observed_mutant: Use each test row's observed mutant log10 affinity as its wild-type prediction. This is an observed comparator, not a prospective predictor.
baseline.fit_scope: Group and global medians use training complexes only; no selection or tuning.

metrics: test-complex mean absolute error in log10(M)
